set_aside.subject: R0-23 email-verified mark output
set_aside.question: Which concrete account-view operation returns the email-verified mark, and which principal may observe it?
options: Only an administrator's staff-account view returns it
A staff member's own account/session view also returns it
Every representation of a staff account returns it
set_aside.default_guess: Return it only in the administrator-authorized staff-account view.

witness.initial: An active staff account has its email-verified mark set and both its holder and an administrator have valid sessions.
events: The administrator reads the staff account through staff administration.
The holder reads whatever self-account or current-session representation the portal provides.
outcomes: Only the administrator's response contains the mark.
Both responses contain the mark because each is an 'account view'.
witness.observer: The staff-account holder and API clients consuming account representations

set_aside.subject: R0-23 email-verified mark lifecycle
set_aside.text: A staff account keeps a recorded "email verified" mark: the administrator's activation, the first administrator's creation (R0-07) and the recovery override (R0-20) set it
set_aside.question: What value does the recorded mark have, and what does the account view show, after an ordinary staff account is created but before it is activated?
options: A recorded true value from creation
set_aside.default_guess: Record false at ordinary account creation and set it to true on activation.

witness.initial: No ordinary staff account exists for a new employee.
events: An administrator creates the account, leaving it pending_verification.
Before activating it, the administrator reads its account view.
outcomes: The view shows the email-verified mark as false.
The view shows the mark as absent or null because it is not recorded until activation.
witness.observer: The administrator and any API client consuming the staff-account view
